title: 🎁 Community Freebies in Pittsburgh - Great Finds All Around Town
text:
7 hours ago Pittsburgh neighbors are giving away some very useful free items this week, from furniture and appliances to garden gear and moving boxes.
Browse the list below and see what might be a good fit for your home.
Yard Sale – September 26th in Plum Item: Yard sale with various items for sale (not all may be free, but worth a look)
Details: Yard sale this Saturday , 9:00 AM–4:00 PM at 38 Brushy Ridge Ct.
Location: Plum, Pittsburgh, PA
Condition: Mixed household items (not detailed in listing)
Source: nextdoor.com
👉 See this item on nextdoor.com
CURB ALERT! Free Brown Leather/Fabric Couch – Ben Avon Item: Free Pottery Barn couches
Details: Brown leather and fabric upholstered couches, well loved by humans and pets , but still sturdy and usable . Set out as a curb alert; you load and haul.
Location: On the curb at 152 Dickson Ave, Ben Avon, Pittsburgh, PA
Condition: Used, pet-friendly home, shows wear but described as sturdy.
Source: nextdoor.com
👉 See this item on nextdoor.com
Ikea Ektorp Sofa – Squirrel Hill North Item: Ikea Ektorp red sofa
Details: Comfortable red sofa with removable, washable covers . You can also buy new covers from Ikea if you want to change the color.
Home type: Non-smoking, pet-friendly house.
Location: Squirrel Hill North, Pittsburgh, PA
Condition: Used but maintained; washable covers are a plus.
Source: nextdoor.com
👉 See this item on nextdoor.com
Assorted Cardboard Boxes – Mt. Lebanon Sunset Hills Item: Various cardboard boxes
Details: Mixed sizes of boxes, great for moving or storage .
Location: Mt. Lebanon – Sunset Hills, Pittsburgh, PA (exact spot shared by owner)
How to get them: Text 412-901-9978 for the exact location .
Condition: Used boxes, but suitable for packing and storing.
Source: nextdoor.com
👉 See this item on nextdoor.com
Outdoor Patio Set – Morningside Item: Outdoor patio set
Details: Includes two chairs with cushions and two glass-top tables . A nice basic set to freshen up a porch, balcony, or small yard.
Location: Morningside, Pittsburgh, PA
Condition: Used; specific wear not described.
Source: nextdoor.com
👉 See this item on nextdoor.com
Free Air Conditioner – Southside Slopes Item: Air conditioner with remote
Details: Unit works well and comes with its remote . Exact BTUs and size are not listed, so you may want to ask the poster.
Location: 1616 St Patrick St, Southside Slopes, Pittsburgh, PA
Condition: Working, used.
Source: nextdoor.com
👉 See this item on nextdoor.com
Lawn-Boy Lawn Mowers (2) – Blackridge / Churchill Boro Item: Two green Lawn-Boy lawn mowers from the 1970s
Details: Both are in operable condition but not currently running . They need some TLC (repairs or tune-up). Owner is switching to electric and wants them gone. Great for someone who likes fixing small engines or needs parts.
Location: 2320 Forest Drive, Churchill Boro (Blackridge, Pittsburgh, PA)
Contact: Call 412-901-1627 (owner notes: no texts; prefers a phone call ).
Condition: Vintage, not running now, for repair or parts.
Source: nextdoor.com
👉 See this item on nextdoor.com
Car Floor Mats Set – Mt. Lebanon Sunset Hills Item: Car floor mats set
Details: New mats that came from a 2027 Honda CR-V (check with the owner if that’s a typo for a different year). Marked MPU 15226 (meet-up/pickup in ZIP code 15226).
Location: Mt. Lebanon – Sunset Hills, Pittsburgh, PA
Condition: New .
Source: nextdoor.com
